scope: All explicit model tie resolutions and head-only FP64 replay from fixed saved raw scores;no new training or seed replication
limitations: Uniform model-tie regret differs from the conditional ORACLE uniform-tie reference.
FP64 head replay does not rerun the network or its training in FP64.
All on-N comparisons use the SAME actual model near set;no retrospective gate replacement.
Local NumPy/libm replay and the source runtime reported values are distinguished.
Natural-label tie errors are not Bayes regret.
